_about: 676d (owner 16 Nov, decision 3A): the ONE key the isolated QA app (com.shelf.launcher.qa) is signed with, so every QA build updates the installed QA app in place (its settings kept) and a Google OAuth client registered for it keeps matching. Public certificate fingerprints only - the key itself is never in the repository (docs/claude/QA_SIGNING_KEY.md).
